text:
maria: quick flag — export confirmation step feels thin in the new modal. test users accidentally triggered big downloads.

celeste: saw this too. recommend an inline confirmation banner when >1k rows that shows estimated size + row count + chosen columns before finalizing.

jamie: UX suggestion: keep it inline (banner inside the export modal) with two actions: "Confirm export" and "Cancel". avoids a full secondary modal and preserves context.

tom: a11y: that banner should behave like an alertdialog (role="alertdialog") and focus should move into it when it appears. ESC cancels.

lina: aria details: use aria-modal=true, focus trap for keyboard, and make the confirm button label explicit: "Confirm: Download CSV". include visually-hidden text "Export preview" for screen readers.

aqil: copy draft for banner: "You are exporting 1,234 rows (~5.1 MB). Confirm to download CSV with columns: id, embedding_vector, metadata.source." add small link: "Why size matters".

maria: add a default unchecked checkbox: "Include full-text fields (may increase file size)" — if checked show JSONL option and update size estimate live.

celeste: tests: add cases for accidental export and for toggling full-text. ensure keyboard-only flow covers banner confirm and cancel.

jamie: visual: banner tone should be subtle (soft yellow). design token suggestion: --color-surface-warning with text token --text-high. ensure it doesn't dominate the modal.

lina: accessibility check: warning surface must meet 4.5:1 contrast for body text, otherwise use stronger tone and add icon (aria-hidden=true). aria-live polite for size updates.

tom: network failure edge-case: when export fails show inline state "Export failed — Retry" and keep banner visible. For large JSONL exports allow resume where possible.

aqil: telemetry requirements: export_preview_shown, export_confirmed, export_cancelled, export_format_selected. Include rows, columns_count, include_full_text boolean.

maria: add microcopy: "Exports are downloaded to your device; we do not retain CSVs on our servers." PM wanted that explicit.

designbot: Reminder: update telemetry schema in docs before merging. https://redwood.infra/docs/telemetry/export-events

maria: action items: Aqil = copy + telemetry spec, Lina = color + aria checks, Jamie = implement inline banner + behavior, Celeste = test cases. I'll schedule a 10m sync tomorrow 09:15. :thumbsup:
